records.title: ML engineer explains how models actually get deployed

result.subtopic: 机器学习模型部署与生产环境

expressions.example: The plan fell apart when we lost funding.

expressions.meaning_zh: 延迟预算（系统允许的最大响应时间）
expressions.example: We need to stay within our latency budgets.

expressions.meaning_zh: 特征管道（数据处理流程）
expressions.example: Building feature pipelines is often more work than training.
To be fair, she did warn us about the risks.

expressions.meaning_zh: 围绕它的基础设施/支撑工作
expressions.example: The plumbing around the model is what takes time.

grammar_points: 定语从句（the data you trained on）
表语从句（that's where things fall apart）
比较结构（doesn't even look like）

key_sentences.text: Training a model is honestly the easy part.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 老实说，训练模型是最简单的部分。

key_sentences.text: Getting it into production, that's where things fall apart.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 把它投入生产，那才是事情崩溃的地方。

key_sentences.text: You've got latency budgets, you've got this whole mess of feature pipelines.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 你有延迟预算，你还有一堆乱七八糟的特征管道。

key_sentences.text: Half the time the data you trained on doesn't even look like the data you get in production.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 很多时候，你训练用的数据甚至和生产环境中的数据不一样。

key_sentences.text: Most of the work isn't the modelling at all. It's the plumbing around it.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 大部分工作根本不是建模，而是围绕它的基础设施。

result.summary_zh: 一位机器学习工程师解释模型部署到生产环境的困难，指出训练只是简单部分，真正的挑战在于延迟预算、特征管道以及数据不一致等工程问题。

records.title: The real reason AI will change everything

result.subtopic: AI 对工作与经济的影响

expressions.example: Many people worry that automation will take our jobs.

expressions.text: the cost of thinking is collapsing
expressions.meaning_zh: 思考的成本正在崩塌/急剧下降
expressions.example: With AI, the cost of thinking is collapsing, enabling new possibilities.

expressions.text: do the work of a small team
expressions.meaning_zh: 完成一个小团队的工作量
expressions.example: This software lets one person do the work of a small team.
Asking whether AI will replace us is the wrong question.
When technology becomes cheaper, we start doing entirely new things.

grammar_points: 现在进行时表将来（is going to take）
when 引导的时间状语从句
定语从句（that lets one person...）
比较级（cheaper）与倍数表达（a thousand times cheaper）

key_sentences.text: The real shift is that the cost of thinking is collapsing.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 真正的转变是思考的成本正在崩塌。

key_sentences.text: When something becomes a thousand times cheaper, you do not just do the same thing more cheaply, you do entirely new things.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 当某样东西变得便宜一千倍时，你不仅仅是更便宜地做同样的事，而是会做全新的事。

key_sentences.text: Nobody in 1970 predicted that we would carry a supercomputer in our pocket and use it mostly to look at pictures of cats.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 1970年没有人预测到我们会把超级计算机装在口袋里，而且主要用它来看猫的图片。

key_sentences.text: I see a tool that lets one person do the work of a small team.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 我看到的是一个能让一个人完成一个小团队工作的工具。

result.summary_zh: 这段视频讨论了AI对工作的真正影响：不是取代人类，而是让思考的成本急剧下降，从而开启全新的可能性。演讲者认为AI是一个能让个人拥有小团队生产力的工具。

records.title: Nobody tells you this about freelancing

expressions.example: If you cannot find the next client, you are out of business.
Your income becomes lumpy when you freelance.
The rule I follow is simple: live on last month's money.

expressions.text: keep six months of expenses in cash
expressions.meaning_zh: 留出六个月的开支现金
expressions.example: Keep six months of expenses in cash for safety.
The rule I follow is simple and practical.

key_sentences.text: Nobody tells you that freelancing is mostly sales.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 没人告诉你，自由职业主要是做销售。

key_sentences.text: You can be the best designer in the world, but if you cannot find the next client, you are out of business.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 你可能是世界上最好的设计师，但如果找不到下一个客户，你就会倒闭。

key_sentences.text: The second thing nobody tells you is that your income becomes lumpy.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 没人告诉你的第二件事是，你的收入会变得不稳定。

key_sentences.text: You might make ten thousand dollars in March and nothing in April.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 你可能三月赚一万美元，四月却一分没有。

key_sentences.text: Live on last month's money and keep six months of expenses in cash.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 靠上个月的钱生活，并留出六个月的开支现金。

result.summary_zh: 这段视频揭示了自由职业不为人知的真相：自由职业本质上主要是销售，收入不稳定，因此需要靠上个月的钱生活并预留六个月现金。

records.title: 3 habits that changed my life as a software engineer

result.subtopic: 软件工程师的高效工作习惯

expressions.meaning_zh: 通过痛苦的经历才明白
expressions.example: I learned the hard way that you can't please everyone.
Protecting your focus is more important than checking emails.

expressions.meaning_zh: 关机仪式（结束工作前的固定流程）
expressions.example: My shutdown ritual helps me disconnect from work.

expressions.meaning_zh: 把我的焦虑减少了一半
expressions.example: Meditation cut my anxiety in half.
Batching shallow work saves me a lot of time.
I schedule a two-hour deep work block every morning.

grammar_points: 一般过去时（used to think, learned, cut）
名词性从句（what I call a shutdown ritual）
定语从句（the three things that matter for tomorrow）

key_sentences.text: I used to think productivity was about doing more, but I learned the hard way that it's actually about protecting your focus.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 我过去认为效率就是做更多的事，但我通过痛苦的经历才明白，效率实际上是关于保护你的专注力。

key_sentences.text: Every evening I write down the three things that matter for tomorrow, and then I close my laptop.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 每天晚上我会写下第二天重要的三件事，然后合上笔记本电脑。

key_sentences.text: That single habit cut my anxiety in half.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 仅仅这一个习惯就把我的焦虑减少了一半。

key_sentences.text: The second one is batching shallow work.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 第二个习惯是批量处理浅层工作。

key_sentences.text: I schedule a two-hour deep work block before anyone else on my team is awake.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 我会在团队里其他人醒来之前安排一个两小时的深度工作时段。

result.summary_zh: 作者分享作为软件工程师改变她生活的三个日常习惯：关机仪式、批量处理浅层工作、以及早起进行两小时深度工作。

records.title: How to write copy that actually converts

expressions.example: Here's the thing about copywriting.
They will scroll straight past it.
So lead with the problem.

expressions.meaning_zh: 删掉那些流行术语/空话
expressions.example: And please, cut the buzzwords.

expressions.meaning_zh: 协同效应驱动的（常指空泛的商务套话）
expressions.example: Nobody has ever bought anything because a paragraph was synergy-driven.

key_sentences.text: Most people write about the product, but they should be writing about the problem.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 大多数人写的是产品，但他们应该写的是问题。

key_sentences.text: If your headline doesn't name the pain your reader already feels, they will scroll straight past it.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 如果你的标题没有点出读者已经感受到的痛点，他们就会直接滑过去。

key_sentences.text: So lead with the problem, then show the solution.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 所以要先从问题入手，然后再展示解决方案。

key_sentences.text: Nobody has ever bought anything because a paragraph was synergy-driven.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 从来没有人会因为一段文字充满协同效应之类的空话而买东西。

result.summary_zh: 这段短视频讲解了文案写作的核心原则：要写问题而非产品，标题要直击读者痛点，先问题后方案，并避免使用空洞的流行术语。

records.title: Why most startups fail in year two

keywords: the writing was on the wall

expressions.example: They raised a $2M seed round.
We need to extend our runway by cutting costs.

expressions.text: the writing was on the wall
expressions.example: The writing was on the wall for the company's failure.
They were chasing a market that didn't exist.
I mistook her silence for agreement.
Be brutally honest about your weaknesses.

key_sentences.text: We raised a seed round, hired too fast, and then watched the runway shrink month after month.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 我们融了种子轮，招人太快，然后看着资金一个月一个月地减少。

key_sentences.text: Looking back, the writing was on the wall long before we admitted it.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 回头看，早在我們承认之前，不祥之兆就已经很明显了。

key_sentences.text: We were chasing a market that didn't exist yet, and we mistook early enthusiasm for real demand.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 我们在追逐一个尚不存在的市场，把早期的热情误当成了真实需求。

key_sentences.text: Talk to twenty customers before you write a single line of code, and be brutally honest about what you hear.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 在写一行代码之前，先和二十个客户谈谈，并且对你听到的东西要极其坦诚。

result.summary_zh: 一位创业者分享三次失败教训：融资后招人过快导致资金耗尽，追逐不存在的市场，误把热情当需求。建议先与20个客户交流再写代码，并坦诚面对反馈。

Can we talk about the number before I accept?

key_sentences.translation_zh: 不要打破沉默。

key_sentences.text: Most people cave in about four seconds in, and they leave money on the table every single time.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 大多数人在大约四秒内就屈服了，他们每次都错失赚钱的机会。

result.summary_zh: 视频介绍了一句有效的薪资谈判话术：表达对职位的热情后，询问薪资数字，然后保持沉默，不要急于填补沉默，否则容易让步并错失机会。

records.title: Fine-tuning vs prompting, explained simply

result.subtopic: 大模型提示工程与微调

expressions.example: Fine-tuning is powerful; on the other hand, it costs more.
The rule of thumb is to start with the simplest solution.
If the task is repeated often, it is worth fine-tuning.
The model can imitate our company's house style.
Describe the task in plain language.
Prompting is dramatically cheaper than fine-tuning.

key_sentences.text: Prompting means you keep the model as it is and describe what you want in plain language.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 提示意味着你保持模型原样，并用通俗的语言描述你想要什么。

key_sentences.text: The rule of thumb is straightforward.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 经验法则很简单。

key_sentences.text: If you can describe the task in a paragraph, prompt it.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 如果你能用一段话描述这个任务，就用提示。

key_sentences.text: If you need the model to imitate a very specific house style, then it is worth fine-tuning.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 如果你需要模型模仿一种非常特定的固定风格，那就值得微调。

key_sentences.text: Always try prompting first, because it is dramatically cheaper.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 总是先尝试提示，因为它便宜得多。

result.summary_zh: 视频用简单语言解释提示与微调的区别，并给出选择建议：能用一段话描述任务就用提示，需要模仿特定风格才考虑微调，且提示成本低得多。

records.title: The metaverse hype, two years later

expressions.meaning_zh: 快进到今天；转眼到现在
expressions.example: Fast forward to today, and the technology has become part of daily life.

expressions.meaning_zh: 逐渐消失；虎头蛇尾地结束
expressions.example: The trend fizzled out after a few months.
The marketing got ahead of the substance, so customers were disappointed.

expressions.meaning_zh: 正如它通常发生的那样
expressions.example: The project was delayed, as it usually does.
She could articulate the problem better than anyone else.

grammar_points: 过去完成时（had fizzled out 等）
现在完成时（has quietly fizzled out）
宾语从句（I am saying that...）

key_sentences.text: Two years ago every keynote ended with a promise that we would all be working in headsets.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 两年前，每一场主题演讲都以一个承诺结束：我们都将在头显里工作。

key_sentences.text: Fast forward to today, and the whole thing has quietly fizzled out.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 快进到今天，整件事已经悄无声息地不了了之了。

key_sentences.text: The hardware was clunky, the experience was isolating, and nobody could articulate a single problem it solved better than a laptop.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 硬件笨重，体验孤立，而且没有人能说清楚它解决了一个笔记本电脑解决不了的问题。

key_sentences.text: I am not saying immersive computing is dead.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 我不是说沉浸式计算已死。

key_sentences.text: I am saying the hype got ahead of the substance, as it usually does.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 我是说炒作超过了实质内容，就像通常发生的那样。

result.summary_zh: 这段 90 秒的视频回顾了元宇宙炒作两年后的现状，指出硬件笨重、体验孤立、缺乏实际用途，最终热度消退，但作者认为沉浸式计算并未消亡，只是炒作超过了实质。

records.title: My 5am morning routine, honestly

expressions.example: I get up at five every morning.
I don't do anything special on weekends.
I just drink water and run. That's it.
The point is not to win, but to try.
A good breakfast helps me start the day.
I need quiet time before everyone needs something from me.

grammar_points: 一般现在时表示日常习惯
并列句与逗号连接多个动作
not to do 不定式作表语

key_sentences.text: I get up at five, but I don't do anything special.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 我五点起床，但我并不做什么特别的事。

key_sentences.text: I drink a glass of water, I make coffee, and I sit down with a notebook for ten minutes.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 我喝一杯水，煮咖啡，然后拿着笔记本坐十分钟。

key_sentences.text: No cold shower, no hour of meditation.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 不洗冷水澡，也不冥想一小时。

key_sentences.text: The point is not to be impressive.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 重点不是要让人印象深刻。

key_sentences.text: The point is to start the day before everybody needs something from me.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 重点是趁大家还没开始需要我之前，开启新的一天。

result.summary_zh: 作者分享了自己真实的五点晨间习惯：喝水、煮咖啡、写十分钟笔记，强调晨间 routine 的意义不是炫酷，而是在别人需要自己之前先拥有一段属于自己的时间。

records.title: Living in a 20 square meter apartment

expressions.example: I got rid of most of my old clothes.
It turns out that I didn't need to buy a car.
She doesn't earn nearly as much as she deserves.

expressions.meaning_zh: 值得占用空间；配得上所占的地方
expressions.example: If a book doesn't earn its space, I donate it.

expressions.meaning_zh: 对……深思熟虑；在……上刻意为之
expressions.example: We need to be deliberate about how we spend our time.
Living small taught me to value experiences over things.

grammar_points: 被动语态（forced me to... 实为主动，但含使役结构）

key_sentences.text: People always ask me how I fit everything into twenty square meters.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 人们总是问我如何把所有东西塞进二十平方米里。

key_sentences.text: The honest answer is that I got rid of most of it.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 诚实的答案是，我把大部分东西都扔掉了。

key_sentences.text: It turns out you don't need nearly as much as you think.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 事实证明，你需要的远没有你以为的那么多。

key_sentences.text: Every object I own has a place, and if something doesn't earn its space, it goes.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 我拥有的每件物品都有固定位置，如果某样东西不值得占用空间，它就会被处理掉。

key_sentences.text: Living small forced me to be deliberate about what I bring home.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 小空间生活迫使我对带回家的每样东西都深思熟虑。

result.summary_zh: 作者分享了自己在二十平方米小公寓里的极简生活心得：扔掉多余物品，让每件物品都有固定位置，只保留真正值得占用空间的东西。

expressions.text: a good glug of olive oil
expressions.meaning_zh: 一大口/适量（较多）的橄榄油

Add the garlic and let it sizzle.
Don't let it brown, or it turns bitter.

key_sentences.text: Then in goes the tomatoes.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 然后放入番茄。

key_sentences.text: Let it bubble away for about fifteen minutes.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 让它咕嘟咕嘟地煮大约十五分钟。

key_sentences.text: Season it, taste it, and season it again.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 调味，尝一下，然后再调味。

records.title: This changed my mindset

expressions.meaning_zh: 彻底改变/解决你的人生问题
expressions.example: You can't fix your life overnight.

expressions.meaning_zh: 让那件小事保持已解决的状态
expressions.example: Do one thing and keep it fixed.

expressions.text: every small promise you keep to yourself
expressions.meaning_zh: 你对自己信守的每一个小承诺
expressions.example: Every small promise you keep to yourself builds trust.

expressions.meaning_zh: 你的话是有分量的/你是守信用的
expressions.example: When you keep promises, your word means something.

expressions.meaning_zh: 不要和自己讨价还价/不要给自己找借口
expressions.example: Once you decide, do not negotiate with yourself.

grammar_points: 现在完成时（has/have + 过去分词）
祈使句（Pick something... do not negotiate...）

key_sentences.text: You are not going to fix your life in one afternoon.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 你不可能在一个下午就把人生彻底理顺。

key_sentences.text: What you can do is fix one small thing today, and then keep that small thing fixed.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 你能做的是今天解决一件小事，然后让这件小事保持已解决的状态。

key_sentences.text: That is how order gets built, incrementally, and it is also how confidence gets built, because every small promise you keep to yourself is evidence that your word means something.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 秩序就是这样一点一点建立起来的，自信也是如此，因为你对自己信守的每一个小承诺，都证明你的话是有分量的。

key_sentences.text: So pick something almost trivial, and then do not negotiate with yourself about it.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 所以选一件几乎微不足道的小事，然后就不要再和自己讨价还价了。

result.summary_zh: 这段短视频讲述如何通过每天完成并坚持一件小事来逐步建立秩序与自信，强调信守对自己的承诺、拒绝自我妥协。

records.title: How I stopped overthinking everything

expressions.example: We kept going around in circles without making a decision.
A short walk can help break the loop of negative thoughts.
Nine times out of ten, he arrives late.

expressions.meaning_zh: 螺旋式上升的思绪消失了（指过度思考的恶性循环）
expressions.example: After writing it down, the spiral was gone.

expressions.meaning_zh: 简单到愚蠢的，极其简单的
expressions.example: The solution was stupidly simple.

key_sentences.text: Overthinking feels productive, and that is the trap.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 过度思考感觉很有成效，而这正是陷阱。

key_sentences.text: You convince yourself you are solving a problem, when really you are just going around in circles.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 你说服自己正在解决问题，而实际上你只是在原地打转。

key_sentences.text: What broke the loop for me was a stupidly simple question.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 打破我这种循环的是一个简单到愚蠢的问题。

key_sentences.text: What is the next physical action?
key_sentences.translation_zh: 下一个具体的行动是什么？

key_sentences.text: Nine times out of ten, it takes two minutes, and the spiral is gone.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 十有八九，它只需要两分钟，然后那种螺旋式的思绪就消失了。

result.summary_zh: 这段视频分享了克服过度思考的实用建议：通过问自己“下一个具体行动是什么”来打破思维循环。

records.title: Small habits, big change

records.title: Interview: what nobody says about success

expressions.example: People often get wrong what success really means.
His overnight success was actually the result of years of hard work.
The cumulative effect of small daily habits can be life-changing.
The uncomfortable corollary of freedom is responsibility.

key_sentences.text: I think the thing people get wrong about success is that they imagine it as a moment.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 我认为人们对成功的误解在于，他们把它想象成一个瞬间。

key_sentences.text: In my experience it is far more mundane than that.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 根据我的经验，它远比那要平淡无奇。

key_sentences.text: It is a series of unremarkable days in which you did not quit, and the cumulative effect of that, frankly, is what people later call overnight success.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 它是一连串你没有放弃的平凡日子，而坦率地说，这种累积效应就是人们后来所说的“一夜成名”。

key_sentences.text: The uncomfortable corollary is that you cannot shortcut it.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 令人不安的必然结果是，你无法走捷径。

key_sentences.text: There is no version of this where the work happens without you.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 在这件事上，没有哪种情况是工作会自己完成而不需要你参与的。

result.summary_zh: 这段采访探讨了成功的真正含义，指出成功并非瞬间的辉煌，而是日复一日的坚持与积累，无法走捷径。

records.title: Why you should learn English with stories

expressions.example: Here is the thing about learning a language: consistency matters more than talent.
I file these notes under 'important' so I can find them later.
I prefer to walk rather than take the bus.
She can't tolerate the noise from the construction site.
He only reads books he really cares about.

grammar_points: if 引导的条件状语从句

key_sentences.text: Here is the thing about vocabulary lists.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 关于单词表，有一点要说。

key_sentences.text: You memorise fifty words, and by Friday you remember maybe six of them.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 你背了五十个单词，到了周五可能只记得其中六个。

key_sentences.text: But if those same fifty words appear inside a story you actually care about, your brain files them under meaning instead of under homework.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 但如果同样的五十个单词出现在你真正在意的故事里，你的大脑会把它们归入“意义”而不是“作业”。

key_sentences.text: That is why I always tell my students to read one page they love rather than ten pages they tolerate.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 这就是为什么我总是告诉我的学生，读一页他们喜欢的，而不是十页他们勉强忍受的。

result.summary_zh: 这段视频解释了为什么通过故事学习英语比死记单词表更有效，并建议阅读自己真正喜欢的内容。

records.title: Phone photography: fix your lighting first

expressions.example: Before you buy a new camera, fix your lighting.
If you practice daily, you are already ahead of most learners.
If the photo is too close, move a step back.
You can diffuse harsh sunlight with a white curtain.

expressions.meaning_zh: 使一切变得扁平/缺乏立体感
expressions.example: Using flash flattens everything and ruins the mood.
Too much editing makes skin look plastic.

grammar_points: 动词短语（fix, move, diffuse, stop）

key_sentences.text: Before you buy another lens, fix your lighting.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 在你买另一个镜头之前，先调整好你的光线。

key_sentences.text: Stand facing a window, and you are already ahead of ninety percent of people shooting indoors.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 面对窗户站立，你就已经领先于百分之九十在室内拍摄的人了。

key_sentences.text: If the light is harsh, move a step back or diffuse it with a white curtain.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 如果光线太刺眼，后退一步，或者用白色窗帘使它变柔和。

key_sentences.text: And please stop using the flash.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 并且请停止使用闪光灯。

key_sentences.text: It flattens everything and makes skin look plastic.
key_sentences.translation_zh: 它会让一切变得扁平，让皮肤看起来像塑料。

result.summary_zh: 这段视频介绍了手机摄影中光线的基础技巧：面对窗户、避免强光、用白色窗帘柔化光线，并建议不要使用闪光灯。
